native.fsoe_profile: Source-qualified base declaration proposal; ETG5120 enhancements require independent matched edition/implementation bounds.
native.fsoe_role: Actual safety protocol instance role; EtherCAT main-device/subdevice roles are independent.
native.fsoe_transport_binding: Required actual black-channel link/process-data/buffer mapping reference; no implicit EtherCAT100M/Ethernet inherited rate.
native.fsoe_implementation_source: Required matched actual safety device/firmware/protocol edition and supported data limits reference, unknown.
native.fsoe_connection_source: Required actual unique connection ID/slave address/parameter/configuration reference, unknown.
native.fsoe_timing_source: Required actual direction-dependent watchdog/whole exchange/transport mapping bounds and endpoint timing reference, unknown.
native.fsoe_direction: Actual safe-data direction. Configured input/output lengths may differ; never duplicate one length into both.
native.fsoe_master_safe_bytes: Actual master-to-slave safe-data capacity, unknown. One byte or even count; bounded by actual device/process-data mapping.
native.fsoe_slave_safe_bytes: Actual slave-to-master safe-data capacity, unknown, independent of master direction. No universal1486-byte maximum.
native.fsoe_crc_count: Actual CRC word count=ceil(selected safe bytes/2). One-byte exception uses virtual zero in CRC calculation, not an extra wire payload byte.
native.fsoe_crc_word_bytes: Baseline two-octet CRC field per block; not a single checksum overhead for all safe data.
native.fsoe_command_bytes: Baseline one command octet; not an EtherCAT datagram header.
native.fsoe_connection_bytes: Baseline two ConnID octets at end of PDU; connection identifier differs from safety slave address.
native.fsoe_frame_bytes: Actual safety container CMD+safe data+2*CRCcount+ConnID. Six-byte minimum corresponds to one safe byte; excludes black-channel framing.
native.fsoe_pdo_capacity_bytes: Actual mapped black-channel process-data container capacity; full FSoE frame must fit, not just safe payload.
native.fsoe_state: Actual protocol state, unknown. Saved state declaration does not execute handshake or release safe outputs.
native.fsoe_data_command: Actual outgoing data-state command, unknown. Independent peer command is not inferred; no auto ProcessData release.
native.fsoe_command: Actual wire command octet. Public base Reset0x2A/Data Process0x36/FailSafe0x08 constraints; remaining startup command encoding requires source.
native.fsoe_conn_id: Actual16-bit ConnID unknown. Zero before connection allocation/reset; Data requires nonzero. Uniqueness requires actual network configuration.
native.fsoe_slave_address: Actual configured16-bit safety slave address, unknown; must match endpoint setting. Distinct from EtherCAT address and ConnID.
native.fsoe_peer_address: Actual peer accepted/configured safety slave address, unknown, must equal selected endpoint address; scalar equality is not commissioning evidence.
native.fsoe_session_id: Actual locally generated16-bit session ID, unknown. Not default0, not an on-wire field in every Data PDU.
native.fsoe_peer_session_id: Actual independently generated peer session ID, unknown. Not forced equal to local session or copied from it.
native.fsoe_sequence: Actual internal virtual sequence, unknown; base Data1..65535, absent as a standalone wire field. Increment/rollover/CRC-change mechanism needs executor.
native.fsoe_crc0: Actual current16-bit CRC0, unknown. Scalar bounds do not recompute CRC chain/virtual sequence/session/ConnID/block index.
native.fsoe_previous_crc0: Actual previous received CRC0 in inherited chain, unknown. Not default0 outside actual reset.
native.fsoe_crc_source: Actual encoded/container/chain/sequence/session/block-index integrity evidence, unknown. Safety CRC is not cryptographic authentication.
native.fsoe_master_watchdog_ms: Actual base communication watchdog1..65535ms from matched configuration; no universal shortest1ms or sampled1000ms default.
native.fsoe_slave_watchdog_ms: Actual peer accepted same connection communication watchdog, independently sourced; setting alone is not a live watchdog or safety-response certificate.
native.fsoe_exchange_bound_ms: Actual complete bidirectional exchange bound, unknown, must be below both configured watchdogs. Not a single EtherCAT frame cycle.
native.fsoe_parameter_bytes: Actual complete parameter-transfer stream bytes, unknown. Fragmented across frames if needed; not restricted to one frame or copied safe-data length.
native.fsoe_parameter_remaining_bytes: Actual remaining parameter stream count0..actual total, unknown. Counter alone does not certify accepted safety application parameters.
native.fsoe_parameters_accepted: Actual peer parameter acceptance unknown; Data requires true declaration, but protocol/runtime acceptance remains unexecuted.
native.fsoe_mapping_source: Actual ESI/PDO/black-channel buffering and direction/mapping version evidence, unknown; require verification after parameter changes.
native.fsoe_safe_output_source: Actual defined failure/output response and safety application configuration, unknown. Do not infer all-zero application safe state universally.
native.fsoe_safety_requirement: Actual project safety-integrity requirement, unknown. Protocol capability alone does not certify device/system SIL or PL.
native.fsoe_assurance_source: Actual matched safety-device/system validation/response/certificate reference, unknown. NIS declaration checks are not a safety certification.
native.payload_bytes: Actual selected-direction safe-data octets; base one byte or even positive count. No8-byte proposal or1486 universal maximum. PDO complete container capacity is separately checked.

removed.bitrate: Safety application protocol has no own physical rate; explicit registered black-channel binding supplies independent rate.
removed.qos_priority: No universal priority3; safety transaction/black channel mechanism differ.
removed.reserved_bandwidth_percent: Actual transport scheduling/resources rather than reservation0 guarantee.
removed.sync_method: FSoE watchdog/CRC/sequence is distinct from Ethernet PTP/NTP/DC synchronization.
removed.retransmission_enabled: No universal retry switch; state-specific Session retry cannot be generalized to Data.
removed.retransmission_delay_ms: No universal retry0ms; protocol state and actual watchdog govern exchange.
removed.gateway_maximum_throughput: No universal100M safety gateway capacity; actual black-channel transport/queues require own profile.
removed.queue_policy: No generic FIFO certification; master/slave exchange and actual black-channel buffering are separately evidenced.
removed.mtu_bytes: FSoE frame is a mapped safety container, not Ethernet MTU1500.
removed.duplex: Black channel selected independently; no universal FULL Ethernet mode for FSoE.
removed.vlan_id: No own Ethernet VLAN0; actual lower link has its own VLAN.
removed.rate_limit_bit_s: No own network policer0; actual lower transport resources have their own fields.
